category.name: Model APIs and inference
category.description: LLM, embedding and multimodal model endpoints an agent can delegate sub-tasks to.

entries.name: Anthropic Claude API
entries.desc_en: Send messages to Claude models for text and vision generation, tool use, batch jobs and document analysis.
entries.notes: docs.anthropic.com and docs.claude.com redirect to platform.claude.com. Rate limits depend on usage tier. The API's MCP connector lets Claude call remote MCP servers; there is no MCP server that wraps the API itself.

entries.name: Cohere API
entries.desc_en: Call chat, embed, rerank and classify endpoints for text generation, semantic search and RAG.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. Trial keys are not for production use. v2 API is current; v1 is legacy.

entries.name: DeepSeek API
entries.desc_en: Send chat and reasoning requests to DeepSeek models via an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible REST API.
entries.notes: No native SDK: use the OpenAI SDK (base_url https://api.deepseek.com) or the Anthropic SDK (https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). Off-peak hours (UTC) are discounted.

entries.name: fal.ai
entries.desc_en: Generate images, video, audio and 3D with 1,000+ hosted models via queued REST or real-time WebSocket.
entries.notes: The auth header prefix is 'Key', not 'Bearer'. The MCP server accepts an API key or OAuth. Long jobs use the queue API (submit, status, result).

entries.name: Fireworks AI
entries.desc_en: Run serverless or dedicated inference and fine-tuning for open models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The Responses API can call external MCP servers as tools.

entries.name: Google Gemini API
entries.free_tier: free tier: rate-limited access to Flash/Pro models
entries.desc_en: Generate text and images, analyze multimodal input (video, audio, PDFs), and run code execution with Gemini models.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation; it does not run inference. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Google is replacing standard API keys with authorization keys; unrestricted standard keys are rejected in 2026, so use a current key type. Google publishes a Discovery document, not an OpenAPI spec.

entries.name: Groq API
entries.free_tier: free tier: rate-limited per model, no card
entries.desc_en: Run fast LLM chat, tool use and speech-to-text on hosted open models via an OpenAI-compatible API.
entries.notes: Free-tier limits vary by model (e.g. 30 RPM / 1K RPD); see console.groq.com/settings/limits. Not to be confused with xAI Grok.

entries.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
entries.free_tier: free tier: monthly credits (more with PRO)
entries.desc_en: Call hundreds of open-weight chat, vision, image, video and audio models across many providers with one HF token.
entries.notes: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint (router.huggingface.co/v1) handles chat only; use InferenceClient for other tasks. The token needs the 'Make calls to Inference Providers' scope. Pick a provider with a model suffix such as :fastest or :cheapest.

entries.name: Mistral AI API
entries.free_tier: free tier: Studio free mode, rate-limited
entries.desc_en: Run chat completions, embeddings, OCR and document processing with Mistral models via REST.
entries.notes: Official MCP (same API key) currently exposes only Studio Skills management tools, not chat inference; call the REST API for inference.

entries.name: OpenAI API
entries.desc_en: Generate text, images, audio and embeddings, and run tool-calling via the Responses and Chat Completions APIs.
entries.notes: Docs moved from platform.openai.com to developers.openai.com (old URLs redirect). Usage-based billing with a payment method; rate limits scale with usage tier. OpenAI MCP docs cover building MCP servers for ChatGPT, not an MCP wrapping the API.

entries.name: OpenRouter
entries.desc_en: Route chat requests to hundreds of LLMs from many providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint with fallback.
entries.notes: The official remote MCP server uses OAuth PKCE and mints a 7-day key with a $10 default spend limit. It includes send-message and generate-image tools. OAuth PKCE is also available for apps.

entries.name: PiAPI
entries.desc_en: Generate images, video and music through one API proxying Midjourney, Flux, Kling and other models.
entries.notes: Third-party reseller, not the model owner. The Midjourney access is unofficial, so it can break or violate Midjourney's terms of service. Tasks are async (create task, then poll or webhook).

entries.name: Replicate
entries.desc_en: Run thousands of hosted image, video, audio and text models via HTTP predictions; also fine-tune and deploy.
entries.notes: Billed per second of compute or per output. The MCP server is also available locally via npx replicate-mcp.

entries.name: Together AI
entries.desc_en: Run serverless inference, batch jobs, fine-tuning and dedicated GPU endpoints for open-source models.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The API is OpenAI-compatible.

entries.name: Vercel AI Gateway
entries.free_tier: free tier: monthly credits on subset of models
entries.desc_en: Send chat, image, embedding and rerank requests to 100+ models through one gateway with failover and spend tracking.
entries.notes: The base URL https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh works with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs. Vercel's MCP server is for the whole platform and does not run inference. Tokens have no markup. BYOK requires the paid tier. Free-tier overage returns 429. On Vercel, OIDC tokens can replace the API key.

entries.name: Voyage AI (embeddings/rerank)
entries.free_tier: free tier: 200M tokens on current models
entries.desc_en: Generate text, code and multimodal embeddings and rerank documents for RAG and semantic search.
entries.notes: Owned by MongoDB, but the standalone API at api.voyageai.com is still self-serve. Free tokens do not apply to the Batch API.

entries.name: xAI Grok API
entries.desc_en: Generate text, images, video and voice with Grok models, with built-in web search and code tools.
entries.notes: The account must have prepaid credits (console.x.ai). The API is OpenAI-compatible (/v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions). Official MCP server only searches documentation.
